description: New chat room creation modal with user search autocomplete (T-401, T-402). Implement a modal component that allows users to search for other accounts, select them as recipients (shown as tags), optionally set a group name for 2+ recipients, and create the chat room via the existing apiCreateDmChatRoom API.
steps: Create app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/new_chat_room_modal.tsx implementing: (a) modal overlay with close button, (b) 'To:' input field with autocomplete, (c) selected users displayed as removable tag chips above search results, (d) search results list showing avatar+name+handle from the v2/search API (type=accounts), (e) when 2+ users selected show a 'Group name' text input, (f) 'Start conversation' button that calls apiCreateDmChatRoom with account_ids and optional title, (g) on success navigate to the new room via react-router. Use the existing apiGetSearch from mastodon/api/search.ts with type='accounts' for user search. Debounce search input by 300ms.

Update app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/chat_room_list_header.tsx to: (a) make the 'new message' button functional by adding onClick handler that opens the modal, (b) add state to track modal open/closed, (c) render NewChatRoomModal when open.
Update app/javascript/mastodon/actions/dm.ts to make createChatRoom return a Promise so the modal can await the result and navigate to the new room.

Add SCSS styles to app/javascript/styles/mastodon/dm.scss for: .dm-new-chat-modal (overlay, backdrop, content container), .dm-new-chat-modal__header, .dm-new-chat-modal__search-input, .dm-new-chat-modal__tags (chip display), .dm-new-chat-modal__tag (individual removable tag), .dm-new-chat-modal__results (scrollable list), .dm-new-chat-modal__result-item (hover state), .dm-new-chat-modal__group-name, .dm-new-chat-modal__submit-btn. Follow design doc colors and spacing.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking the new message button in the chat room list header opens the modal
Typing in the search field triggers account search after 300ms debounce
Clicking a search result adds the user as a tag chip and clears the search
Selected tags can be removed by clicking X on them
When 2+ users are selected, a group name input appears
Clicking 'Start conversation' calls the API and navigates to the new room on success
Pressing Escape or clicking outside closes the modal
findings: Strict ESLint rules in this project: (1) react-hooks/set-state-in-effect disallows calling setState synchronously in useEffect bodies, (2) react-hooks/refs disallows accessing refs during render, (3) react/jsx-no-bind disallows arrow functions in JSX props. Solution: use child components with useCallback for handlers, and use conditional rendering (unmount/remount) instead of effect-based state reset. The project uses useHistory from react-router-dom (not useNavigate). Pre-commit hook runs eslint, stylelint, tsc, oxfmt, and i18n:extract.
